text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I hear a familiar voice while on a walk…

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Somebody help me!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Gyaaah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I go running toward the source, only to find Taiki Shuttle in the school field tugging at some vines.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Urk… Trainer! Help me out here!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: The director asked me to harvest these here pumpkins!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: That's right! My hometown's famous for our pumpkin festival!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: It's got stuff like a biggest pumpkin contest and a race where ya gotta lug a pumpkin with you when ya run!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Not to mention singin' and dancin' under the stars! It's real exciting!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Once I heard the word "pumpkin," there was no way I couldn't help!
choice_data_list: Time to put that experience to good use!
Time to put that experience to good use!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: But now that I think about it… I've never actually harvested a pumpkin before.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Even though I never missed a festival… Haha.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: What I'm tryin' to say is… ya gotta help me out, Trainer!
choice_data_list: I'll show you how it's done.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: A competition? You mean…

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: You wanna see who can harvest 'em the fastest?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: That sounds awful fun! I got this in the bag!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Racing to see who can harvest the most pumpkins, Taiki Shuttle and I have a fun time clearing the whole field.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, I end up helping Taiki Shuttle with the pumpkin harvesting.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Oh, now it makes sense! You gotta clear a gap so ya can get on in there, right?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Ya know, I just might be able to put this to use when I run too! Let's go try it out in training!
choice_data_list: After we finish harvesting all these.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Oh, right…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We both get covered in mud harvesting the pumpkins, but at least it seems she might have learned something.
